1.4.8.beta.1 (#1838)

* ✔️ Fixed overlay timer stopping when slide was presented

- Changing output style updates the template properly in the output window
- Focus draw now fades in gently

- Fixed unable to add icons

* Fixed pro import ó

* Fixed all lint errors (#1796)

* Formatting

* Accessibility improvements (#1800)

* Mostly accessibility fixes

* Simplified keydown events

* Refactor components to use centralized clickable utilities

Replace duplicate keydown/click handlers across multiple components:

All handlers now use consistent logic from utils/clickable.ts for
Enter/Space key handling, improving code maintainability and
accessibility compliance.

* Finished cleaning up click events

* Fixed import paths

* Media thumbnail performance (#1802)

* Replaced nested setTimeouts with a single, reused animationFrame

* Added debounce to limit redraws during scrolling.

* Caching name, index and styles to minimize re-renders

* Fixed shutdown process. (#1801)

* Fixed dev shutdown process.

* Disabled startDev for now

* Delete slide from show / Remove group from layout

* Handle soft line breaks (shift-enter) in PowerPoint import

* issue-1818

Added get_variables call to return all variables
Added get_variable {"id?": string, "name?": string} to search for variable

Added id_pause_timer to pause a timer by ID
Added name_pause_timer to pause a timer by name
Added id_stop_timer to stop a timer by ID
Added name_stop_timer to stop a timer by name

* Removed Variable Type

Decided not to use this when creating the varaibles API

* Fixes

* Fixes

* 🚩 Updated languages

* 🚩 Updated languages

- Fixed shows removed if same name as deleted in cloud
- Warning when deleting slides also added to a different layout

* ✨ Common actions only showing by default
- Custom confirm popup
- Fixed fsb Bible import not working
- Fixed item deleted if selected while event was deleted
- Fixed media loop data resetting when changing to media edit while outputted
- Fixed media fit always using style from first output when played from drawer
- Fixed child slide label a few pixels shorter than parent
- Day/month string dynamic values
- Fixed renaming group not working if group was not in layout
- Fixed layout name not set in project when created
- Small tweaks

* ✔️ Fixed slide removed from layout when setting global group on child slide
- Fixed incorrect slide indexes removed from layout when selected in specific order

* 📰 Updated font reader
- Default included font is a bit thicker
- Minor label tweaks

* ✔️ Option to use hostname instead of IP as connection QR
- Fixed chords not showing up in slide preview if enabled

* Fixed background zoom for both video and pictures

* ✔️ OutputShow improvement

* Fixed background zoom animation

* feat(scripture): add translation swapping for collections (#1836)

Allow operators to swap between translations in scripture
collections using a swap button in the bottom toolbar. Updates both
the reference label and displayed verse content.

* Bible collection preview

* ✨ Timer stop icon instead of reset
- Small tweaks
- Version update

* feat: Enhance search index and quicksearch UI

Add a fast inverted search index and Bible index for much faster lookups (buildSearchIndex, fastSearch, buildBibleIndex, fastBibleSearch).
Introduce index invalidation (invalidateSearchIndex) when the text cache is loaded or saved so the index is rebuilt when data changes. Extend quicksearch features and UX: category filters (all, songs, bible, media, settings), highlighted token matches, glowing placeholder indicator, snippet previews for song lyrics and Bible verses, and improved transitions/styles. Integrate the index-based Bible search with a fallback to the existing library search; use local scripture cache and build an index when available.
Update quicksearch API to accept category and raw search value, and adapt result generation to include descriptions and previews.
Add a new translation key (main.search_anything).

- UI: removed category bar and related styles; detect #hashtag (e.g. #shows, #audio, #overlays) and strip it from the query.
- Categories: rename 'songs' -> 'shows' and add 'audio' and 'overlays' categories; wire audio playlists/streams and overlay results into quicksearch results and triggers.
- Highlighting: prioritize exact phrase matches, then token-based highlighting (matches any word), with longer words matched first.
- Media: add option to restrict media results to audio files and set appropriate icons for audio/media.
- Bible/search index: bump behavior to support more results and finer-grained indexing (index shorter tokens, n-grams up to 5 words, search-term generation improvements) and add a Bible index version to force rebuilds when needed.

* feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing (#2648)

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* Enhance chord parsing for lyrics with chords above text

Improve the quick lyrics feature to properly parse traditional chord sheets
where chords appear on lines above the corresponding lyrics. This addresses
the common use case where users paste lyrics formatted with chords positioned
above the words they align with.

Changes:
- Enhanced isChordLine() function to detect complex chord patterns including
  slash chords (C/G), extended chords (Fadd9, Gsus), and major/minor variations
- Added preprocessLines() function to handle chord line detection and processing
- Implemented insertChordsIntoLyrics() to accurately place chords at their exact
  column positions from the chord line, preserving visual alignment
- Modified convertText() to preprocess chord lines before section splitting
- Removed duplicate chord processing in createSlide() function
- Fixed empty line handling after section headers ([Verse], [Chorus], etc.)
- Cleaned up console.log statement and improved code formatting

The parser now correctly converts input like:
        C     F    C
Lord, I come, I confess

Into proper inline format:
Lord, I co[C]me, I [F]confe[C]ss

This maintains the exact positioning from the original chord sheet while
creating properly formatted slides without unwanted empty lines.

* Fix chord attachment to ensure chords are always attached to words

Modify the chord parsing logic to prevent standalone chords that appear
detached from any text. When a chord position aligns with a space character,
the chord is automatically moved to attach to the beginning of the next word.

This fixes cases where input like:
  C    All my life you have been faithful
  All my life you have been faithful

Would produce: [C] All my life you have been faithful
Now produces: [C]All my life you have been faithful

The fix works by adjusting chord positions during the detection phase,
moving any chord that would land on a space to the start of the next
word, ensuring all chords are properly attached to lyrics.

Introduce index invalidation (invalidateSearchIndex) when the text cache is loaded or saved so the index is rebuilt when data changes. - UI: removed category bar and related styles; detect #hashtag (e.g. #shows, #audio, #overlays) and strip it from the query.
- Categories: rename 'songs' -> 'shows' and add 'audio' and 'overlays' categories; wire audio playlists/streams and overlay results into quicksearch results and triggers.
- Highlighting: prioritize exact phrase matches, then token-based highlighting (matches any word), with longer words matched first.
- Media: add option to restrict media results to audio files and set appropriate icons for audio/media.
- Bible/search index: bump behavior to support more results and finer-grained indexing (index shorter tokens, n-grams up to 5 words, search-term generation improvements) and add a Bible index version to force rebuilds when needed.

* feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

When clicking a book name to auto-focus on verse 1, then shift-clicking
to extend the selection, verse 1 would appear twice if it was split into
multiple parts (1_1, 1_2, etc).

The issue occurred because:

- Split verses feature created [1_1, 1_2] instead
- Range selection added both plain '1' and split '1_1', '1_2'

Fix: After range selection, filter out plain verse IDs when their split
versions exist in the selection.

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing (#2648)

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

* fix(text-editor): prevent chord movement corruption in text editor

Fixed two bugs in slide matching logic that caused text corruption when moving chords:

1. Slide fingerprinting: Create chord-position-agnostic fingerprint using sorted unique chords instead of position-dependent chord order
2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* Enhance chord parsing for lyrics with chords above text

Improve the quick lyrics feature to properly parse traditional chord sheets
where chords appear on lines above the corresponding lyrics. This addresses
the common use case where users paste lyrics formatted with chords positioned
above the words they align with.

Changes:
- Enhanced isChordLine() function to detect complex chord patterns including
  slash chords (C/G), extended chords (Fadd9, Gsus), and major/minor variations
- Added preprocessLines() function to handle chord line detection and processing
- Implemented insertChordsIntoLyrics() to accurately place chords at their exact
  column positions from the chord line, preserving visual alignment
- Modified convertText() to preprocess chord lines before section splitting
- Removed duplicate chord processing in createSlide() function
- Fixed empty line handling after section headers ([Verse], [Chorus], etc.)
- Cleaned up console.log statement and improved code formatting

The parser now correctly converts input like:
        C     F    C
Lord, I come, I confess

Into proper inline format:
Lord, I co[C]me, I [F]confe[C]ss

This maintains the exact positioning from the original chord sheet while
creating properly formatted slides without unwanted empty lines.

* Fix chord attachment to ensure chords are always attached to words

Modify the chord parsing logic to prevent standalone chords that appear
detached from any text. When a chord position aligns with a space character,
the chord is automatically moved to attach to the beginning of the next word.

This fixes cases where input like:
  C    All my life you have been faithful
  All my life you have been faithful

Would produce: [C] All my life you have been faithful
Now produces: [C]All my life you have been faithful

The fix works by adjusting chord positions during the detection phase,
moving any chord that would land on a space to the start of the next
word, ensuring all chords are properly attached to lyrics.

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing (#2648)

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

* Fixed formatting

* Fix scripture template override applying wrong styles to verses 2+ (#2653)

* Fix scripture template override applying wrong styles to verses 2+

When using 'Overwrite Scripture with Template' in output styles, verses beyond the first were getting matched to the wrong template text object (falling back to text[0] which is the verse number template instead of verse text template).

Now intelligently matches verse text objects to {scripture_text} placeholder and verse numbers to {scripture_number} placeholder based on customType flag.

- UI: removed category bar and related styles; detect #hashtag (e.g. #shows, #audio, #overlays) and strip it from the query.
- Categories: rename 'songs' -> 'shows' and add 'audio' and 'overlays' categories; wire audio playlists/streams and overlay results into quicksearch results and triggers.
- Highlighting: prioritize exact phrase matches, then token-based highlighting (matches any word), with longer words matched first.
- Media: add option to restrict media results to audio files and set appropriate icons for audio/media.
- Bible/search index: bump behavior to support more results and finer-grained indexing (index shorter tokens, n-grams up to 5 words, search-term generation improvements) and add a Bible index version to force rebuilds when needed.

* feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

* fix(text-editor): prevent chord movement corruption in text editor

Fixed two bugs in slide matching logic that caused text corruption when moving chords:

1. Slide fingerprinting: Create chord-position-agnostic fingerprint using sorted unique chords instead of position-dependent chord order
2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* Enhance chord parsing for lyrics with chords above text

Improve the quick lyrics feature to properly parse traditional chord sheets
where chords appear on lines above the corresponding lyrics. This addresses
the common use case where users paste lyrics formatted with chords positioned
above the words they align with.

Changes:
- Enhanced isChordLine() function to detect complex chord patterns including
  slash chords (C/G), extended chords (Fadd9, Gsus), and major/minor variations
- Added preprocessLines() function to handle chord line detection and processing
- Implemented insertChordsIntoLyrics() to accurately place chords at their exact
  column positions from the chord line, preserving visual alignment
- Modified convertText() to preprocess chord lines before section splitting
- Removed duplicate chord processing in createSlide() function
- Fixed empty line handling after section headers ([Verse], [Chorus], etc.)
- Cleaned up console.log statement and improved code formatting

The parser now correctly converts input like:
        C     F    C
Lord, I come, I confess

Into proper inline format:
Lord, I co[C]me, I [F]confe[C]ss

This maintains the exact positioning from the original chord sheet while
creating properly formatted slides without unwanted empty lines.

* Fix chord attachment to ensure chords are always attached to words

Modify the chord parsing logic to prevent standalone chords that appear
detached from any text. When a chord position aligns with a space character,
the chord is automatically moved to attach to the beginning of the next word.

This fixes cases where input like:
  C    All my life you have been faithful
  All my life you have been faithful

Would produce: [C] All my life you have been faithful
Now produces: [C]All my life you have been faithful

The fix works by adjusting chord positions during the detection phase,
moving any chord that would land on a space to the start of the next
word, ensuring all chords are properly attached to lyrics.

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing (#2648)

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

* Fixed formatting

When using 'Overwrite Scripture with Template' in output styles, verses beyond the first were getting matched to the wrong template text object (falling back to text[0] which is the verse number template instead of verse text template).

Now intelligently matches verse text objects to {scripture_text} placeholder and verse numbers to {scripture_number} placeholder based on customType flag.

Add a fast inverted search index and Bible index for much faster lookups (buildSearchIndex, fastSearch, buildBibleIndex, fastBibleSearch).
Introduce index invalidation (invalidateSearchIndex) when the text cache is loaded or saved so the index is rebuilt when data changes. * feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing (#2648)

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

* fix(text-editor): prevent chord movement corruption in text editor

Fixed two bugs in slide matching logic that caused text corruption when moving chords:

1. Slide fingerprinting: Create chord-position-agnostic fingerprint using sorted unique chords instead of position-dependent chord order
2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* Enhance chord parsing for lyrics with chords above text

Improve the quick lyrics feature to properly parse traditional chord sheets
where chords appear on lines above the corresponding lyrics. This addresses
the common use case where users paste lyrics formatted with chords positioned
above the words they align with.

Changes:
- Enhanced isChordLine() function to detect complex chord patterns including
  slash chords (C/G), extended chords (Fadd9, Gsus), and major/minor variations
- Added preprocessLines() function to handle chord line detection and processing
- Implemented insertChordsIntoLyrics() to accurately place chords at their exact
  column positions from the chord line, preserving visual alignment
- Modified convertText() to preprocess chord lines before section splitting
- Removed duplicate chord processing in createSlide() function
- Fixed empty line handling after section headers ([Verse], [Chorus], etc.)
- Cleaned up console.log statement and improved code formatting

The parser now correctly converts input like:
        C     F    C
Lord, I come, I confess

Into proper inline format:
Lord, I co[C]me, I [F]confe[C]ss

This maintains the exact positioning from the original chord sheet while
creating properly formatted slides without unwanted empty lines.

* Fix chord attachment to ensure chords are always attached to words

Modify the chord parsing logic to prevent standalone chords that appear
detached from any text. When a chord position aligns with a space character,
the chord is automatically moved to attach to the beginning of the next word.

This fixes cases where input like:
  C    All my life you have been faithful
  All my life you have been faithful

Would produce: [C] All my life you have been faithful
Now produces: [C]All my life you have been faithful

The fix works by adjusting chord positions during the detection phase,
moving any chord that would land on a space to the start of the next
word, ensuring all chords are properly attached to lyrics.
